children: OPENLANE extended the maturities of its U.S. and Canadian receivables funding platforms to January 31, 2030. In the U.S., Automotive Finance Corporation and AFC Funding executed a Second Amendment to their Tenth Amended and Restated Receivables Purchase Agreement with Fairway Finance Company and a lender syndicate. In Canada, Automotive Finance Canada and the company completed Amendment No. 4 to the Receivables Purchase Agreement, with related changes to the loan and security agreement, involving Computershare Trust Company of Canada, BMO Nesbitt Burns, and Royal Bank of Canada. The extensions are aimed at maintaining liquidity, stability, and growth support across North American dealer financing operations.
